item.title: How can I round up categories in R?
item.description: Hi! I am a newbie, using R for my quantitive research methods class. I was doing some exercises and I have identifid outliers - hotels with 1.5 stars. My guiding solution suggests "rounding these up" to 2 stars. Do any of you have any idea on how can i do that? I think it just means changing a rating from 1.5 stars to 2, but I am not sure how to do that. Any tips will be greatly appreciated.
